$description: Dark palette. Palette D changes: bg.page → deep green (was reused charcoal), text.heading → sageLight (was plumLight), focus.ring → tealStrong (was magentaLight), brand.eyebrow added (amberLabel). brand.link unchanged (rustLight already matches Palette D's dark-link decision). brand.primary/primaryStrong/accent and solid status.<name> fills remain un-overridden, same rationale as before: white text on top holds contrast regardless of theme.

page.$description: Palette D: deep green direction for dark mode, no pink. Was {color.charcoal}.

heading.$description: Palette D: reuses the existing inverse-surface muted text color for dark headings. Was {color.plumLight}.

eyebrow.$description: Palette D: new dark override, reuses the existing inverse-surface label color. Previously un-overridden (fell back to light magenta).

ring.$description: Palette D: reuses the existing info-on-dark teal for the focus ring. Was {color.magentaLight}.
